unmatched.what: OUTSIDE WINDOW (6 days early): Fight Aging! reported Life Biosciences' first-in-human data for ER-100 (partial reprogramming, eye): three participants, well tolerated to day 56, two of three glaucoma patients improved visual field. Registry NCT07290244 last updated 2026-05-19.
unmatched.why_it_matters: First human data for the reprogramming approach Altos is built on; relevant to the Altos record and probably to the site's leaves, but dated before 2026-10-25 so it may already be in the records or the previous reading.
